Event-driven simulation: work out only what changed

A 32-bit CPU will have thousands of parts; going over all of them in
every round until nothing changes does not scale. A part is now worked
out again only when a net it reads changed; switches, clocks, buttons
and the ROM (which look at more than their inputs) are polled at every
settling. Same results - every level and test passes unchanged - and a
clock step of the 4-bit computer drops from 0.38 to 0.03 ms.
